# <span id="aanchor436"></span> <span id="aanchor437"></span> Tracking

Bar coded charts can be tracked electronically to quickly determine where charts are in an office. There are eight customizable stages of the chart progression. At each stage, a chart can be "wanded" to record the date of that event. For example: As charts are received via mail delivery, each one is "wanded" into the system as received.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Chart Tracking screen:

Go to **Tools** \> **Charts** \> **Tracking**.
